Later final issues refined the same area without reversing the seed: FHIR-17639 for empty/whitespace-only strings, FHIR-40563 for string and markdown regexes, FHIR-38714 for markdown CommonMark/GFM no-inline-HTML rules, FHIR-32800 for Unicode serialization handling, and FHIR-48953 for newline guidance.

The current source says markdown is a FHIR string subject to string rules, states the 1,048,576-character string limit and UTF-8 byte-size distinction, covers control characters and whitespace behavior, and gives both string and markdown the non-empty ^[\s\S]+$ regex.
